doc.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Los Angeles and its musicians
summary: He says he never connected with L.A., and they mention Gerald Wilson and Snooky Young.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Los Angeles was an interesting place at that time, but I could never really connect with L.A. It was too – I don’t even know how to describe it, because it was some good people in L.A., but by – I think by 1960, Charles, Ornette, Cherry, Hig, all of them, they went to New York. Garnet Brown was out there too, and he did the same thing. Eventually Garnet, I think, went back to L.A. But it was – and it still is a very strange place, even today. It pretty much – like my grandson said, it is what it is.
I’m thinking, Gerald Wilson’s been out there for a long time.
They got Snooky Young out there.
Yeah, well, Snooky went out with The Tonight Show band.
